trickyParts: Harness hazard: /legion/harness/setup.sh runs `pg_ctl status`, which cannot see a postmaster started from another role's container (separate PID namespace), so it deletes pgdata/postmaster.pid, and that Postgres shuts itself down within a minute (log: 'received immediate shutdown request ... could not open file postmaster.pid'). Running setup.sh in my container stopped the implementer's Postgres; it now runs from the tester's container. A reviewer that runs setup.sh will stop it again: harmless once testing is over, but run setup.sh only when no other role is mid-run.
web/dist was rebuilt at the head's CSS after the mutation runs, so the shared dist serves the PR's rule.
